description: This Java source file contains integration tests for uploading telemetry data via the CoAP protocol to an Eclipse Hono component. It defines a test class 'TelemetryCoapIT' which extends 'CoapTestBase' and uses JUnit and Vert.x testing frameworks to verify telemetry message uploads using QoS 1.

classes.name: TelemetryCoapIT
classes.description: A JUnit test class that performs integration testing of telemetry data uploads over CoAP protocol in the Eclipse Hono framework.

methods.name: createConsumer
methods.description: Creates a telemetry consumer for a specified tenant with a message processing callback.

methods.name: getPutResource
methods.description: Returns the URI path template for PUT requests for a specific tenant and device.

methods.name: getPostResource
methods.description: Returns the URI path for POST requests for telemetry data.

methods.name: getMessageType
methods.description: Returns the type of CoAP message used (NON in this case).

methods.name: testUploadUsingQoS1
methods.description: JUnit test verifying successful upload of telemetry messages with QoS 1 via CoAP.
